title: Ay Chaand Muharram Tu Hi Baatha, Khatoon Ka Chaand
body:
Ay Chaand Muharram Tu Hi Baatha, Khatoon Ka Chaand Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abaad Hain Duniya Saari (x2) Zahra Ka Chaman Veeran Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Par Jibareel Ki Zeenat Ka Ku Lasha Tera Pamal Hua (x2)
Bay Goro Kafan Ho Bhai Meray (x2)
Zainab Ko Yahee Armaan Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekha Naa Suna Zaa Hir Aisa Zakhmo Sai Badaan Hai Choor Magar (x2)
Jaari Hai Zubaan Pai Zikera Khuda (x2)
Gardan Pe Khanjar Ravan Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kathi Hai Sakina Abid Ko Is Qaid Mai Mai Maar Jaowoongi (x2)
Chooro Na Akela Bhai (x2)
Thareekh Bohth Zindaan Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ai Kufiyon Mai Hun Bint-e-Ali Aur Waaris-e-Chadaar-e-Zahra Kee (x2)
Deyko Na Tamaasha Sharam Karo (x2)
Ab Zainab Saar Ureeyaan Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aulaad Ka Ghaam Bhaiyon Kay Varaam Kaat Ta Hai Kalayja Kadam Kadaam (x2)
Hai Kaisay Utayay Khoon Bharee (x2)
Akbar Kee Laash Jawaan Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanveer Utta Kaar Asghar Ko Syed Nay Sawalay Aap Kiya (x2)
Tum Bhi Ho Musalman Reham Karo (x2)
Beysheer Kee Khushak Zubaan Hai.
